verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents built-in TOTP code generation, and its desktop app docs say vault contents are accessible offline, which covers the offline half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows codes can be viewed without a Proton account; community comments tie integrated TOTP to paid Pass Plus or Unlimited plans, which suggests an account is part of the model. Missing for 10: evidence that no vendor account is required to see codes, explicit confirmation that TOTP generation (not just vault access) works offline, offline behavior on mobile and extension clients, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, codes generate fully offline — no network, no vendor account required just to see my TOTP codes

citations.quote: Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.
You don’t need to do anything to access Proton Pass offline. Everything in your vaults is accessible whether you’re connected to the internet or not.
